infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VahanLoop uses your camera for vehicle inspection photographs and KYC identity verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VahanLoop requires photo library access to upload vehicle registration documents and photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VahanLoop uses your location to discover nearby rental vehicles and depot pickup hubs.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow VahanLoop to access your camera for vehicle inspection photography.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow VahanLoop to access your photo library to attach vehicle documentation.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow VahanLoop to access your location to show available vehicles near you.
